translations.answer: The development unit for G1 includes software and network coordination with the internal motion control side; re-flashing may cause version, driver, or communication configuration mismatches, expanding ordinary system issues into whole-machine problems. The situation should be backed up, followed the manufacturer's upgrade path, and placed in a rollback-safe virtual environment or container.
translations.applicability: Applies to G1 EDU under warranty and manufacturer image constraints.
translations.credibility.rationale: Environmental, processing steps, and results have engineering records, but formal cross-validation or independent replication is missing.
translations.details.attempts.0: Maintain the boom but ensure the feet are grounded before activating balance.
translations.details.attempts.1: Stop tasks, fix the boom, return to idle, and cool down externally before investigating the root cause.
translations.details.attempts.2: Keep the manufacturer image, install the SDK according to official documentation.
translations.details.attempts.3: Compile and run a read-only state example.
translations.details.diagnostics.0: Check status, alarms, temperature, and calibration in the Explore App.
translations.details.diagnostics.1: After SSH, check interfaces and SDK2 example, read status before writing control.
translations.details.environments.0: Unitree G1 EDU; onboard Jetson development unit; SDK2 expects Ubuntu 20.04, GCC 9.4, CMake 3.10+.
translations.details.limits.0: The post is a summary of personal experience; external fans are only emergency measures and cannot replace thermal sources or load diagnosis.
translations.details.outcomes.0: The author provides a safe and debugging sequence but does not provide temperature curves or independent replication experiments.
translations.details.problem_statements.0: Why do the legs of G1 move violently when it is in balance or walking mode?
translations.details.problem_statements.1: How should one handle thermal warnings during operation?
translations.details.problem_statements.2: Why should one avoid arbitrarily re-flashing the onboard Jetson?
translations.details.problem_statements.3: What is the minimum test that should be run first when integrating SDK2?
translations.details.safety_notes.0: Always retain the boom, clear the area, establish an emergency stop path, and use a low-risk initial pose; control examples must be validated in a read-only state before gradually releasing them.
translations.details.suspected_causes.0: The balance strategy assumptions regarding contact and state are invalid.
translations.details.suspected_causes.1: Continuous motion causes local motor thermal accumulation.
translations.details.suspected_causes.2: The Jetson image and robot internal software stack are not synchronized.
translations.details.symptoms.0: The balance strategy still attempts to find support and drive the legs when the feet are not grounded.
translations.details.symptoms.1: A loud thermal warning is heard during operation or policy execution.
translations.details.symptoms.2: When the SDK example fails, it is difficult to distinguish between network, DDS, and code issues.
translations.media_summaries.0: All key content of the X Article is in the visible main text; the images mainly showcase the G1 body and protection, and do not serve as log or parameter evidence.
